Scan Notes, a.b.e-book v3.0: Proofed carefully, italics intact. The author uses lots of italics and "quotes", in some cases rather poorly. Also, much of the grammer is suspect, but I didn't want to veer from the DT to the extent that I felt would be necessary. Changed 'British Quotes' to "American Quotes". Did not include the index because of the lack of page numbers in this format, but kept the "Notes" section in case reference is needed. Because of the
charts and use of mathematical characters in Chapter Six, please be cautious when changing this book to another format.
